text:
Ivy Summers: Quick sync - prepping a multi-cloud listing + systems integrator (SMI) attachment for our Appliance SKU. Need owners for: final EULA, hero assets (marketing), AMI/market images (x86 & arm64), Azure managed image id, appliance OVA/upgrade path, SKU rows, trial entitlement caps, support contact for SMI (Marco), and a short integration blurb for the portal. Who can pick what?

Dan Wu: I can take AMIs + GCP images + OVA packaging. Will include a small acceptance script that writes /etc/rsw-validate and exposes /health. Need staging publisher IDs and the SMI test key.

Raina Kapoor: Legal/Compliance here. I need the signed logo release and final EULA PDF. For the SMI blurb we must avoid "joint offering" language; use "listed with" or "integrated with". Also we need an incident contact + SLA bullets for the listing page.

Marco Silva: I'll be the SMI contact. Can confirm SMI quote and co-branded hero. Also confirm they want a co-branded tile and a short deploy guide.

Ivy Summers: Publisher refs for staging (confirm infra): AWS acct 987654321098, GCP project redwood-market-stg, Azure sub res ID /subscriptions/0000-aaaa-1111/resourceGroups/market-stg. Dan, please DM infra for the test key and the exact validation token. Example AMI name: redwood-inf-appl-ami-ubuntu22-<region>-<arch>-2026-05.

Dan Wu: Copy. ETA: AMIs + GCP images by Wed EOD, OVA + checksums Thu AM. Will publish IDs and SHA256 sums here.

Raina Kapoor: Draft SMI blurb: "Redwood Inference Appliance is listed with SMI Partners for deployment and managed services. Customers should contact the SMI partner for on-site support; Redwood provides product-level support." Good to post?

Marco Silva: That reads fine. Can we add: "Contact: marco@smipartners.example" and a link to the SMI deployment guide?

Raina Kapoor: Add contact OK. We'll not include phone in listing. Also adding KMS line: "Customer-managed keys supported in Dedicated, Private, and Appliance; hosted services use Redwood-managed keys by default."

MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MP-6055: "marketplace listing: appliance + SMI integration" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-6055

Ivy Summers: SKU plan: RedwoodInference.API (hosted), RedwoodInference.Dedicated, RedwoodInference.Appliance. Trial: 30d, 60k token cap; trial rate limit 10 rps. Product please confirm quotas and pricing rows.

Dan Wu: Noted - will include marketplace smoke test (curl /health -> 200) and /etc/rsw-validate content.

Marco Silva: I'll coordinate the co-branded hero with marketing and share the signed release.

Raina Kapoor: I'll upload EULA + logo release to MP-6055 once signatures are in. Also adding privacy snippet: "We collect anonymized telemetry for reliability; no PII exported. Customers can opt-out for Dedicated/Private."

Ivy Summers: Action items: Dan = images + OVA + checksums, Marco = SMI assets + contact, Raina = legal artifacts + blurb confirmation, Ivy = pricing rows + intake submission. Target submit: 2026-05-08 COB.

Dan Wu: + will post image IDs here.

Marco Silva: + will send hero sketch to Nora in marketing.

Raina Kapoor: + will upload docs to MP-6055.

Ivy Summers: Thanks all. If anything blocks publishing QA, ping me directly.
